title: I spent Halloween weekend building a WoW-inspired multiplayer arena game with AI. It's playable now!
author: brodyodie
selftext:
Went a little overboard this Halloween and spent almost the whole weekend building something I've wanted to play for a while.

I've always loved WoW arena PvP, and after seeing some of the new browser arena games popping up, I wanted to see how far I could take the idea with the latest models, since it's been maybe a year that I last did any game dev work.

Ended up making **Crucible**, a free browser-based multiplayer PvP game.

It's got 6 playable classes, talents, customizable builds, ranked arenas, battlegrounds, matchmaking, bots, cosmetic progression, and a little 3D world to run around in.

One of my favorite things is that you can instantly swap between all six classes without creating separate characters, and all your builds stay saved.

I've been having a ton of fun playing it. I had someone discover it yesterday, then randomly ran into him again today while he was grinding arenas and experimenting with different class builds.

Would love to hear what other AI game devs think, especially about the gameplay and what you'd prioritize next.

It's free, runs directly in the browser, and doesn't require a download:

[https://cruciblearena.us](https://cruciblearena.us)

Would be cool to get a few people into arenas together!
